'''Usuthas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He worked as a gear component vendor on [[Voss]].

During the [[Invasion of Voss]], Usuthas hid in the [[Judicial Quarter]] Commerce Hall alongside [[Saligon]] and a number of [[Voss (species)|Voss]].<ref name="Chapter 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=1}}</ref>
